kurz: Cream is milk with a lot of fat. With enough fat it can be whipped, boiled without curdling, and makes sauces round.
bild_im_kopf: Like milk with an extra helping of fat droplets.
was_passiert: When whipped, partly opened fat droplets link into a framework around air bubbles. That needs enough fat (whipping or double cream) and cold. A lot of fat also protects against curdling when boiled.
faustregeln: For whipping, use full-fat cream, well chilled.
For cooking, full-fat or double cream: lighter cream can curdle.

rolle.rolle: can be whipped into a foam
